problem: Every tall-tree batch is permanently converted to a material that contains `discard`, even while nothing fades. On tile-based phone GPUs (Apple HSR, Mali/Adreno early-Z) that can cost overdraw for every tree on screen; the perf numbers are Mac-only and Forward+ was vsync-capped, so mobile, the primary target, is unmeasured. The report lists this as a limit but nothing checks it.
fix: Measure one TestFlight/phone build with --no-occlusion vs on in a dense forest view; if it shows, keep the source material and swap in the derived (discard) material only while the node / batch has a fade > 0.

problem: The roof under the survivor keeps 2/16 pixels. In daylight it reads as a faint ghost, but at night (inside-fwd.png, the lab ran at night) the roof is almost invisible, so the owner's 'keep an outline' is weak in the dark. The gate only checks 5-30 % kept, never at night.
fix: Try 3/16-4/16 (INSIDE_DROP 0.75-0.8, still inside the 5-30 % gate) or add a rim/edge term for inside mode; take the roof gate frame once at night as well.

problem: Reads IsoCamera's private _target by string; a rename in IsoCamera silently falls back to the first 'player' in the group (wrong survivor in multiplayer) with no error.
fix: Expose a public getter on IsoCamera (e.g. func target() -> Node3D) and call it; keep the group fallback.

problem: Passes are told apart by camera forward (dot > 0.999). Safe for the sun today (world_lighting keeps its yaw 80-130 deg off the camera axis), but any other camera with the iso orientation (a SubViewport minimap/portrait, a reflection probe face) would also fade props, and a future camera rotation (action-mode camera in the plan) must update occl_view.
fix: Document the rule next to occl_view and in the API section; if a second iso camera appears, gate on a cull-layer bit or a per-viewport global instead.

problem: Inside-mode nodes are scanned linearly every frame (every geom's AABB transformed per frame). Fine for the lab, but W2-BUILDSYS will register one node per roof piece, so a large base is O(roof pieces) per frame with no grid.
fix: File inside nodes in the same 8 m grid and test only the survivor's cell (plus neighbours), or cache world AABBs since pieces are static.

problem: The register has no W2-OCCLUDE section; the spec exists only as STATUS.md rows and owner decisions, so the next reviewer has nothing in the register to check against.
fix: Add a W2-OCCLUDE entry (scope, owner's 2026-10-20 correction, the six pixel gates, the API for W2-BUILDSYS).

problem: Lab lighting depends on when it runs (my 1600x900 shots came out in daylight, at night and at dusk), so screenshots across renderers and sizes are not comparable, and one Forward+ --shot run under heavy machine load hit the 900 s alarm without saving (the rerun saved tree-fwd2.png, at dusk). The gates run pins shadows and pauses, but not the time of day.
fix: Pin the lab's time of day (e.g. noon) at _ready so every shot and gate frame uses the same light.
